proof:
classical
intro β W hstable
by_cases hzero : W = ⊥
· exact Or.inl hzero
· right
  have hjoint : ∃ (w : VK K M) (c : Ix l → K) (j : Ix l),
      w ∈ W ∧ w ≠ 0 ∧ w = ∑ k, c k • β k ∧ c j ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwne⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hzero
    have hex : ∃ j : Ix l, β.repr w j ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hnone
      have hall : ∀ j : Ix l, β.repr w j = 0 := by
        simpa only [not_exists, not_not] using hnone
      apply hwne
      calc
        w = ∑ k, β.repr w k • β k := (β.sum_repr w).symm
        _ = 0 := by simp [hall]
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hex
    exact ⟨w, (fun k => β.repr w k), j, hw, hwne, (β.sum_repr w).symm, hj⟩
  obtain ⟨w, c, j, hw, hwne, hexpand, hcj⟩ := hjoint
  have hcoeff : β.repr w j = c j := by
    rw [hexpand]
    simp
  apply (Submodule.eq_top_iff_forall_basis_mem β).mpr
  intro i
  have haction : matrixUnit β i j w = c j • β i := by
    change β.repr w j • β i = c j • β i
    rw [hcoeff]
  have hmem : c j • β i ∈ W := by
    rw [← haction]
    exact hstable i j w hw
  have hinv := W.smul_mem (c j)⁻¹ hmem
  simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hcj, one_smul] using hinv
